description: Import an OpenAPI 3.x document (as JSON), a Postman v2.x collection (JSON) or a curl command into a new collection, or into `collection_id`. All or nothing, and plan limits are checked first. Credentials are never imported (they become variables). Convert YAML to JSON before sending.

collection_id.description: Add to this collection instead of creating one.

content.description: The document (object or JSON string), or the curl command, e.g. curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/charges.

format.description: What `content` is: an OpenAPI 3.x document, a Postman v2.x collection, a HAR file or a curl command.

name: import_api_spec
